fusions.name: Committed to Memory
fusions.desc: Fires a memorised bolt of arcana that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. It holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Flawless Recital
fusions.desc: Looses 5 rehearsed bolts of arcana at once in a spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 7 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Fluent Casting
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Nature
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
